affiliateManagement.infoNotice: Enable affiliates per listing below. Commission is only charged on completed eligible sales or rental payments — never on deposits, refunds, or barter trades. Affiliate payouts are handled automatically by Unity on your behalf.

rtbTerms.heading: Rent-to-Buy Terms
rtbTerms.enabledNotice: Rent-to-buy is enabled for this listing.
rtbTerms.disabledNotice: Rent-to-buy is not yet enabled for this listing.
rtbTerms.ownershipNotice: You remain the owner of the item until the customer has completed the full ownership-transfer process below — possession and ownership are separate.
rtbTerms.securityDeposit: Security deposit (ZAR, optional — never counts toward the purchase price)
rtbTerms.allowEarlyPayoff: Allow the customer to pay off the remaining balance early
rtbTerms.allowCure: Allow the customer to cure a default and resume the agreement
rtbTerms.securityDepositNotice: Held separately from the purchase price. Refunded when the agreement ends successfully, unless forfeited for a confirmed late return.
rtbTerms.possessionSection: When does the customer take possession?

trigger.percentage: After a percentage of the price is paid
trigger.fullPayment: Only after the full price is paid

rtbTerms.rentalUseNotice: Used only if this agreement ends before ownership transfers — Unity charges its rental commission on this rate for the time the customer actually had the item, never on the purchase price.
rtbTerms.wearDamageStandard: Wear and damage standard (optional — shown to the customer before they accept)
rtbTerms.gracePeriodDays: Grace period before a missed payment becomes default-eligible (days)
rtbTerms.returnWindowDays: Return window after a formal default (days)
rtbTerms.escrowNotice: Instalments are held (escrow-governed) until the agreement completes successfully or is settled after a default — they are not paid out to you immediately.

downgradeFlow.genericError: Something went wrong — please try again.

changes.publicationLimit: Your active publication limit will be lower — some of your listings, requests or posts may need to be deactivated.
changes.saleCommission: Your commission rate on sales will increase.
changes.rentalCommission: Your commission rate on rentals will increase.
changes.advertisingDiscount: Your Advertising discount will be reduced or removed.

changes.advancedTools: You will lose access to bulk tools, duplicate listings and CSV export.

changes.eliteBadge: Your Elite badge will be removed from your profile and listings.
